Problem: Implementation knowledge was scattered across team members, call transcripts, and unstructured documents, resulting in repeated problem-solving and limited reuse of previously developed solutions.
Solution:
- Use-Case Extraction & Solution Generation: An Anthropic-hosted agent analyzes Avoma call transcripts and Freshdesk tickets to identify customer use cases and capture solutions discussed. When no solution was discussed, it proposes one using product documentation.
- Human Review: Implementation Managers review, approve, or revise generated use cases and solutions before they are added to the reusable knowledge base.
- Intelligent Retrieval: A backend agent built in Lovable, powered by custom skills, uses Supermemory to retrieve relevant approved solutions and answer implementation questions without loading the entire documentation corpus into the LLM.
- Current-State Validation: Cross-checks historical solutions against Notion, Slack, Rocketlane projects, and product and API documentation to identify retired features and outdated approaches.
- Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Caches repeat answers at 95%+ relevance, captures user ratings, and routes incorrect answers through a validator agent for classification and admin review.
Impact: Reached 60–65% adoption across the Professional Services team, with approximately 10 queries per user per week and 70–80% reported usefulness. Helps Implementation Managers find answers independently rather than spending time tracking down colleagues.
